messages:
maria.castillo: Quick sync — we need a short playbook for inbound handoff SLAs. There9s a pattern where HubSpot enrichment lag + round-robin retries causes delayed owner assignment and duplicate claims. Can we outline immediate mitigations?

samir.patel: yep seeing it in the metrics. avg time from new lead -> assigned is spiking to 6m when enrichment fails.

jenny_mktg: spike noticed for webinar signups too. conversion drops when assignment >2m.

lisa_salesops: root cause seems twofold: 1) enrichment webhook sometimes returns 202 with deferred ttl; 2) RR service retries due to missing owner id, causing claim races.

noah_eng: quick triage idea: add a short "pending-enrichment" sticky owner state for 90s so RR doesn't reassign. fallback to overflow after 120s.

maria.castillo: i like that. Can we also stop RR from creating duplicate claim attempts if a webhook ack is pending? simple dedupe by lead_id+attempt_ts window.

lisa_salesops: agreed. i'll draft the rule. Proposed minimal playbook steps: 
- mark lead as PENDING_ENRICH when enrichment webhook returns 202
- block RR assignments for PENDING_ENRICH for 90s
- after 90s, if still no owner and enrichment not complete, route to overflow pool
- if RR sees >1 claim in 30s, drop duplicates and log

samir.patel: add a metric: pending_enrich_count and duplicate_claim_rate, alert if duplicate_claim_rate > 0.5% over 15m

hubspot-integration: note: HubSpot webhooks can deliver duplicate events. We recommend idempotency via external_id (lead_id).

lisa_salesops: snippet for webhook handling we'll add to docs: 
```
POST /api/leads/hubspot
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "external_id": "{{lead.id}}",
  "payload": { ... }
}
// server should respond 200 once processed, 202 if queued for enrichment
```

noah_eng: engineering tasks i can own: 
- add PENDING_ENRICH flag + TTL (90s) (PR)
- RR: dedupe by recent attempt window (30s) (PR)
- expose metrics (prometheus) and a dashboard

maria.castillo: ops / playbook tasks: 
- update incoming docs + playbook summary for SDRs
- add escalation path: if overflow gets >25 leads in 10m, page oncall

jenny_mktg: i'll update webinar signup flows to include a lightweight fallback (email notify owner) so we don't lose MQLs during incident windows

devops-bot: deploy triggered: feature/leader-enrich-flag -> staging

noah_eng: staged changes deployed to staging, running integration tests against HubSpot sandbox.

lisa_salesops: can we add a short checklist in playbook for on-call? eg: check enrichment queue, check RR logs (claim_id), backfill owner if required.

maria.castillo: yes — i'll write a 1-pager playbook and ping docs for publication. target: have playbook + runbook + dashboard by EOD tomorrow.

samir.patel: tagging follow-ups: @noah_eng (eng prs), @lisa_salesops (docs + rules), @jenny_mktg (signup fallback), @maria.castillo (publish).

maria.castillo: thanks all — small, timeboxed fixes first. we'll revisit long-term: better enrichment SLAs and idempotent webhooks. :thumbsup:

jenny_mktg: acked. will prepare copy for SDRs explaining temporary overflow behavior.

devops-bot: staging deploy succeeded: feature/leader-enrich-flag (build 20260323-17).

noah_eng: leaving a short log note: added metric pending_enrich_ttl and dedupe window 30s. will open PRs for review shortly.

maria.castillo: perfect — closing thread after PRs go green. thanks :)
